name: Classic Tailoring

intent_defaults.description: A tailored starting point emphasizing proportion, clean finishing, controlled ease and adjustable structure.
intent_defaults.silhouette: Structured regular to close fit, with user-controlled ease and balance.

component_defaults.pockets: Welt, flap or patch pockets as selected

accessibility_defaults: All fit, closure, coverage and material choices remain user-editable.
circularity_defaults: Offer repair, alteration and modular-replacement options where compatible with the wearer intent.
caveats: Tailoring quality depends on pattern, interlining, construction and physical fitting.
The preset does not prescribe a gendered silhouette or body shape.
